definitions.purchase: A paid permanent-unlock transaction, not a subscription, unique human, GM, play session or installation.
definitions.tiers: Humble, Fair and Supporter grant the same permanent unlock. Tier choice represents chosen support price.
definitions.sales: Estimated store-reported sales before commission. Values do not establish literal tax-inclusive cash paid by all customers at checkout.
definitions.translatedEUR: Illustrative reporting translation of Apple dashboard USD at a single ECB reference rate. Exact formulas preserve repeating results; JSON numbers are display/computation approximations. Native source decimal strings are preserved.
definitions.net: Estimated earnings after platform charges and applicable remitted taxes, before own costs and income taxes. Not profit or verified bank cash.

caveats: All displayed download, purchase, gross-sales and proceeds figures include Android beta. Downloads end September 20; financials end September 21. Transactions and non-deduplicated store users do not establish a unique-buyer conversion rate.
Donuts show all-time purchases only: iOS60, Android124, combined184. Historical public-period data is retained as evidence but is not a selectable chart cohort.

Apple App Units and Google new-user acquisitions differ in definition, day boundary, redownload treatment and cross-device identity. Their sum is approximate and does not deduplicate people across stores.
Apple sales subtract refunds and include tax only where included in displayed price; added checkout tax can be absent. Apple refund count was unavailable, so do not claim zero Apple refunds.

Google gross report recorded zero full or partial refunds. At least one order had list priceEUR7.99, customer totalEUR4.99 and estimated netEUR5.70. Promotion funding was not established, so gross is not proved equal to actual cash charged.
Net combines finalized August Google earnings with individual June, July and September order estimates and provisional Apple proceeds. Unverified June/July account-level adjustments may remain.

77 named countries/territories are visible in all-time download data; 16 additional downloads fall in an undisclosed geography bucket. Country gross sales cover22 named territories. The map retains the unallocated downloads outside its geometry.
No available data establishes once-ever versus recurring users, premium versus free engagement, unique GMs versus players or tabletop sessions played.

provenance.method: Independent Decimal reconciliation of dashboard source observations, corrected public Android launch boundary and country sums. Removed binary float serialization residue from Apple US gross and recomputed Apple total from exact tier decimals. No new dashboard extraction performed for this artifact.
